open_points.subject: work balance presentation
open_points.text: State 0 now says work balance is shown as “Completed ahead of payments” or “Unused advance payment”, “or as balanced when it is zero”, while State 1’s Derived views still says it is “presented as `Completed ahead of payments` / `Unused advance payment`” without the zero state.
open_points.question: Must every zero work balance be presented with the `balanced` label, or must the derived-view rule choose one of the two labels it lists?
options: Zero balance uses `balanced`, as the changed State 0 passage and `WorkBalanceLabel` say.
Zero balance is assigned one of `completed_ahead_of_payments` or `unused_advance_payment`, as State 1’s derived-values summary can be read to require.
open_points.default_guess: Use `balanced` whenever work balance is zero.

witness.initial: A project has completed work value of EUR 1,000 and received payments totaling EUR 1,000.
events: A viewer reads the project payment summary.
outcomes: The response carries one of the two labels listed by State 1’s derived-values summary despite the zero balance.
witness.observer: The viewer and any client consuming `PaymentSummaryView`.
